notes: Cartoon faces: round heads with glossy round eyes (a white with a thin outline, a coloured iris, the pupil and a sparkle of light that fades as a fighter gets beaten and goes out when they're knocked out), rounded brows, a button nose and a rounded mouth, each a clean cartoon piece instead of blocks. No more white slivers at the eyes. Beards follow the jaw and leave the mouth clear, and jet-black hair now shows its shading.
